description: Single source for two v6 passages: the abstract's status paragraph (generated as status-abstract.tex) and the introduction's Verification boundary paragraph. tools/build_v6.py writes both from this file; do not edit those sentences in TeX. Each result has a status, lean or paper, and repository evidence paths for it. Phrases are written as objects so that the same phrase reads correctly in "Lean checks ..." and in "For ..., the manuscript gives paper proofs only". When a status changes, also update Section 18 (verification.tex), which keeps the exact formal scopes and fixed source links, and any per-section status remark by hand.

rms-law.abstract: the original RMS law in both directions, with coefficients $1/64$ and $512$ and one distribution-blind upper algorithm
rms-law.boundary: both directions of the original RMS law, with coefficients $1/64$ and $512$ and one distribution-blind upper algorithm

variational-optimizer.boundary: the variational optimizer, which has a separate formal specification

unbiased.abstract: the unbiased characterization with coefficients $1/16$ and $713$
unbiased.boundary: the unbiased characterization with coefficients $1/16$ and $713$

confidence.boundary: the confidence characterization in the observable model, with coefficients $1/64$ and $8192$ and one upper family depending only on budget and failure probability

oracle-lower.boundary: the stronger revealed- and selected-magnitude RMS and confidence lower bounds, including the paper's confidence coefficient $15/(256\sqrt2)$

above-two.abstract: the rare-event rate above exponent two
above-two.boundary: the rare-event rate for power margins above exponent two, in the observable model and by a construction different from \cref{app:above-two}

entropy-tail-coefficients.abstract: the entropy--tail coefficients $10^{-17}$ and $28000$ for every known gap law

finite-direct.abstract: the separate direct closed-quantile bounds for finite laws, with coefficients $10^{-20}$ and $30001$

sharp-factor.abstract: the characterization of the sharp quantile factor as the unique root of its scalar equation, over all gap laws and over finite-support laws

stopping-program.abstract: stopping-program duality and the risk certificates

power-margins-below-two.abstract: the power-margin rates below exponent two

known-law-confidence.boundary: the fixed-confidence rates of \cref{app:known-confidence} and the time-uniform upper bound of \cref{app:anytime}

psi-lower-bound.boundary: the arbitrary-law statistical $\Psi$ lower bound of \cref{app:localization}

time-uniform-lower-bound.abstract: the matching gap-law-dependent time-uniform lower bound
time-uniform-lower-bound.boundary: the matching gap-law-dependent time-uniform lower bound of \cref{app:anytime}

abstract.text: A separate exact-arithmetic certificate gives the sharp factor's decimal bracket.
This manuscript records each result's dependencies and verification scope.

boundary.text: One 713 estimator is fixed before every gap law.
Section~\ref{sec:verification} gives the exact scope and links.
